concept: Growth of Political Ideas and Political Organisations upto 1885
question: Where did Dadabhai Naoroji establish the East India Company Association?
solution:
The correct answer is __London__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Dadabhai Naoroji founded The East India Association in 1866.**
 
• He founded it with Indian members and retired British officials in London.
 
• It was **supplanted by the London Indian Societ**y.
 
• The **objective** behind the association was:
 
 
• to provide a platform for discussing matters and ideas about India,
 
• and to provide representation for Indians to the Government.
 
 
 
• Dadabhai Naoroji** delivered the first lecture at the Association** on 2 May 1867.
 
• The **first Presiden**t of the East India Association was **Lord Lyveden**.
 
• The East India Association incorporated the** National Indian Association in 1949 **and became the Britain, India, and Pakistan Association.
 
• In 1966 it amalgamated with the former India Society, now Royal India, Pakistan, and Ceylon Society, to become the Royal Society for India, Pakistan, and Ceylon.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The London Indian Societ**y

 
 
• **​In 1865, **the London Indian Society was founded **under the guidance of Dadabhai Naoroji.**
 
• It was **formed by Indian students** as a forum to air political grievances.
 
• Europeans were allowed to be honorary members but could not vote or hold office.
 
• Of the founding group of students, they included **W. C. Bonnerjee, Manomohun Ghose, Pherozeshah Mehta and Badruddin Tyabji.**
 
• In 1866, the London Indian Society was superseded by the East India Association, although it did continue to exist in some separate form for a few more years.
